popup_pause_site_default.message: Pause NeoDM on this site for this session

popup_pause_all.message: Pause NeoDM on all sites for this session

popup_pause_hint.message: A session pause resets when the browser closes. While paused, downloads are not captured and the media ribbon is hidden.

popup_ribbon_hint.message: Detects direct video/audio files and streams (HLS and DASH). Protected (DRM) and live streams cannot be saved.

popup_cookies_hint.message: On by default. NeoDM gets the cookies your browser would send for a download address, so sites that need your sign-in accept the download. They go only to the NeoDM app on your PC and are never saved by the extension. Turn this off to stop using them.

popup_session_cookies.message: Pass the browser's session cookies for a download to NeoDM

popup_session_cookies_hint.message: NeoDM receives the cookies your browser sent with that download, so the site accepts it. They go only to the NeoDM app on your PC and are kept encrypted only while the download runs.

popup_capture_hint.message: Downloads are cancelled in the browser and handed to NeoDM. Cancel in NeoDM's dialog to discard one; if NeoDM cannot be reached the browser download is restarted.

popup_types_hint.message: Applies to both the media ribbon and download capture. Unticked types are left to the browser.

popup_recent_hint.message: The last downloads NeoDM looked at and why each was taken or left to the browser. Cleared when the browser closes.

popup_pause_site.message: Pause NeoDM on $HOST$ for this session

popup_paused_all.message: NeoDM is paused on all sites until the browser closes.

popup_paused_site.message: NeoDM is paused on $HOST$ until the browser closes.

popup_not_accepted.message: NeoDM did not accept this media.

popup_version_note.message: NeoDM app $APP$, extension $EXTENSION$. Open Help > Browser extension install guide in NeoDM.

ribbon_partial.message: Partial stream: not a complete video

reason_form_post.message: Form POST download, NeoDM cannot repeat a form submission

reason_post_ambiguous.message: The same address was also posted to a moment ago

reason_unseen.message: The request was not seen by the extension

reason_unreachable.message: NeoDM not reachable, browser kept the download

err_only_http_get.message: Only direct HTTP(S) GET URLs are supported

err_not_durable.message: Application did not durably accept the download

err_not_direct.message: Not a direct HTTP(S) URL. Blob, data and protected streams are unsupported.

status_taken.message: Taken over by NeoDM; the browser download was removed

err_media_gone.message: This media is no longer available on the page.

err_no_ack_url.message: NeoDM did not acknowledge this URL.

err_discarded.message: Discarded: you cancelled the download in NeoDM.

err_cannot_restart.message: NeoDM could not take the download and the browser could not restart it: $URL$

err_restarted.message: NeoDM was unavailable ($REASON$); the download was restarted in the browser.

media_segmented.message: Segmented stream, cannot be saved as one file

ext_description.message: Send downloads and detected media to the NeoDM desktop download manager.

media_youtube.message: YouTube sends video in a protected streaming format that cannot be saved as one file from the browser, so NeoDM cannot capture it from the page.

status_choose_ribbon.message: Several videos were found. Choose the one you want in the NeoDM ribbon on the page.

err_no_video.message: No downloadable video was found on this page.

err_link_page.message: This link is a web page, not a file.

reason_browser_site.message: Left to the browser: this site is on the Sites left to the browser list

reason_handed_back.message: You chose Download in browser instead

reason_duplicate.message: The same download was started twice; the second one was ignored

status_handed_back.message: NeoDM left this download to the browser; it continues there.

popup_sites_none.message: No sites yet. A site is added when NeoDM cannot fetch its file or when you choose Download in browser instead.

popup_sites_hint.message: Downloads from these sites are not captured; the browser handles them.

vb_pair_note.message: Saved as two files (video only and audio only). Joining them comes in a later version.

vb_sent_pair.message: Video and audio sent as two files

vb_reason_drm.message: This video is protected (DRM) and cannot be saved.

vb_reason_stream.message: This video streams in pieces without a playlist, so NeoDM cannot save it.

vb_reason_youtube.message: YouTube streams in a protected format that cannot be saved as one file.

vb_reason_none.message: No file found yet. Try playing the video for a few seconds.

err_stream_unsupported.message: NeoDM cannot save a stream in pieces without a playlist.

popup_why_no_button.message: Why is there no download button?

popup_hidden_none.message: No sites. Use the × on the button and choose "Don't show on this site".

popup_hidden_hint.message: The on-video button is not shown on these sites. Remove a site to show it again.

vb_reason_live.message: Live stream: only finished videos can be saved

vb_stream_pieces.message: Pieces without a playlist cannot be saved

err_stream_drm.message: This video is protected (DRM) and cannot be saved.

err_stream_live.message: This is a live stream. NeoDM saves finished videos only.

ribbon_stream_ok.message: Stream: NeoDM reads the playlist and asks which quality
